title: Jacobian Descent for Multi-Objective Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2406.16232v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many optimization problems require balancing multiple conflicting objectives. To generalize gradient descent, which is limited to single-objective optimization, we introduce Jacobian descent (JD) and its stochastic variants. This algorithm iteratively updates parameters using the Jacobian matrix of a vector-valued objective function, in which each row is the gradient of an individual objective. While several methods to combine gradients already exist in the literature, they generally struggle when the objectives conflict. In contrast, we propose projecting gradients to fully resolve conflict. We prove convergence to the Pareto front in the smooth convex case with this approach, a stronger guarantee than the usual convergence to a weakly Pareto stationary point. Our method also enables instance-wise risk minimization (IWRM), a novel learning paradigm in which the loss of each training example is considered a separate objective.

translated_title: 面向多目标优化的雅可比下降法
translated_abstract: 许多优化问题需要平衡多个相互冲突的目标。为了推广仅限于单目标优化的梯度下降法，我们提出了雅可比下降（Jacobian Descent, JD）及其随机变体。该算法利用向量值目标函数的雅可比矩阵迭代更新参数，其中每一行是单个目标的梯度。虽然文献中已有若干组合梯度的方法，但当目标之间存在冲突时，这些方法通常难以奏效。相比之下，我们提出通过投影梯度来完全解决冲突。我们证明了在光滑凸情形下，该方法能够收敛到帕累托前沿，这是比通常的收敛到弱帕累托平稳点更强的保证。我们的方法还支持实例级风险最小化（IWRM），这是一种新颖的学习范式，将每个训练样本的损失视为一个独立的目标。
tldr: 该论文提出雅可比下降（JD）算法，通过梯度投影完全解决多目标间的冲突，并证明了在光滑凸情形下可收敛到帕累托前沿，进而实现了将每个训练样本损失视为独立目标的新型学习范式——实例级风险最小化（IWRM）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Jacobian Descent (JD), which resolves conflicting objectives via gradient projection and provably converges to the Pareto front in the smooth convex case, enabling instance-wise risk minimization (IWRM), a novel learning paradigm that treats each training example's loss as a separate objective.
